model_annotations.German: The bar chart illustrates the overall performance (in percent) for a set of large language models under an ABS-AOS pattern setting, with each vertical bar representing one model/category. The category axis is the horizontal axis, where individual categories are shown as a sequence of bars but the category names are not visible in the provided image; there is no apparent alphabetical or monotonic sorting because lower and higher bars alternate across the sequence. The value axis is the vertical axis labeled “Overall Performance (%)”, shown on a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 20, 40, and 60 (extending slightly above 60 to accommodate the tallest bars). There are twelve single (non-stacked, non-grouped) bars in different pastel colors (e.g., teal, slate-blue, light blue, mauve, tan, lavender, beige, and light gray variants), each annotated with its exact value above the bar: from left to right the bars read approximately 61.09, 48.28, 24.64, 60.72, 48.83, 27.22, 54.83, 43.79, 46.36, 44.09, 40.87, and 43.54 (%). The shortest bar is 24.64% and the tallest bars are 61.09% and 60.72%, and no bars appear to be specially emphasized beyond the numeric labels placed above them; no legend or explicit tier demarcations are drawn on the axes in the visible chart area.
